ai.notes: The report describes an industrial/logistics and office REIT across Australia, Germany, Singapore, the UK and the Netherlands. People and community content is limited to ESG highlights and framework descriptions. The report points to a separate FY2025 ESG Report (www.frasersproperty.com/reits/flct/who-we-are/sustainability) for detail, so Community should get the automated second look. Compensation-framework mentions of leadership development and learning and development are general language and were not recorded as activities. Code of Business Conduct language encouraging respect for ethnicity and culture is policy only. A director's other directorships (e.g., Thai Beverage) relate to other companies and are not FLCT business activities.
